text:
maya-peops: Hey folks — planning a small Q2 'Thanks & Learn' brown-bag series next Wed/Thu. Goal: 30–40 min talk + 10 min recognition shoutouts. Need an emcee, someone to collect 3 quick 'wins' per team, AV lead, and a snack budget sign-off.

alex-peops: I can emcee one of the sessions — happy to coordinate shoutouts. What time windows are we thinking? :raised_hands: 

tom-eng: We have the All Hands room free 12:15–1:15 on Wed and 5–6 on Thu. Projector + conference room mic OK, but we need someone to test the mic before.

sarah-design: I can make a one-slide template for each shoutout and a poster for the hallway. Also happy to do a quick 2-slide 'how to nominate' explainer.

jordan-mgr: Can we make nomination capture asynchronous? Folks may not be there in person. I can ask my leads to submit 3 highlights each by EOD Tuesday.

kelly-people-ops: Budget check — we have up to $150 per session for snacks and small sign-in swag. Approvers: @maya-peops and finance ping. If we need catering, need final headcount by Tuesday 11am.

maya-peops: Thanks Alex/tom/sarah/jordan. Plan: two sessions (lunch Wed 12:15 and evening Thu 5:00). Alex will emcee Wed, I can emcee Thu. Jordan — can you gather leads' highlights? Sarah — slide template great. Kelly — please book snacks for Wed (12:00 drop) once we have headcount.

lili-bot: Quick reminder — signup form created: https://forms.redwood/thanks-learn-q2 (please fill by Tue 11am). Auto-cc: #people-ops-calendar.

alex-peops: Emcee notes: intro, 3 min house rules, 20–25 min speaker, 10 min shoutouts. Can we limit shoutouts to 30s each to keep to timeframe?

sarah-design: Draft of slide template — paste below: 
```
Slide 1: Session title + agenda
Slide 2: Speaker bio + top 3 learnings
Slide 3: Shoutout slide (name | team | 1-line win)
```
I'll post PNG assets to the team drive by EOD Monday.

jordan-mgr: We'll collect shoutouts as a shared doc. I'll ask managers to paste 3 items each. cc @alex-peops for order.

kelly-people-ops: Catering option: boxed salads + cookie tray = ~$120 for 30. Or pizza + drinks = ~$90. Satiety vs speed? Thoughts?

maya-peops: Leaning pizza for speed/variety. Alex, any dietary restrictions you know of? Otherwise order gluten-free pizzas.

alex-peops: There are a couple veg/gluten folks — we'll order 2 GF, 2 vegan, rest regular.

sarah-design: I'll create a small poster and Slack banner to drive RSVPs. Want a line about accessibility: "Contact us for captioning or dietary needs" — good?

maya-peops: Yes add that line and include a contact (maya-peops). Also add a quiet space note for neurodiversity.

lili-bot: Calendar events created and invites sent to #people-ops and all-hands. Link: https://calendar.redwood/events/thanks-learn-q2.

tom-eng: AV lead volunteers: @tom-eng will test mic at 11:50am on Wed. Need someone to run laptop for slides — Sarah available?

sarah-design: Yep I can run slides Wed lunch. If virtual speaker joins, I'll manage screen share.

kelly-people-ops: Action items roundup:
- Jordan: collect shoutouts (due Tue 11am)
- Sarah: slide assets + poster (due Mon EOD)
- Alex + Maya: emcees confirmed
- Kelly: place pizza order Tue 11:30am once headcount confirmed
- Tom: mic check Wed 11:50am
- Lili-bot: keep RSVP reminder Tuesday 9am

alex-peops: Perfect. Quick ask: can we reserve ~5 min at end for micro-spot awards (on-the-spot kudos cards)? That won't require leadership presence, just handing out cards.

maya-peops: Love it. We'll bring printed cards. Kelly — include printing in budget.

kelly-people-ops: Noted — printing ~ $15. All set on my end.

jordan-mgr: Will compile a short order for shoutouts and share the doc link here when done.

maya-peops: Thank you team — will post the final schedule + RSVP link in General tomorrow. :party-popper: 

lili-bot: RSVP reminder scheduled Tue 9:00am.
